expected_level_description: You can: - lead clinical professional standards for the organisation's digital work - act as a senior clinical voice in decisions about patient safety and care - support the revalidation and professional development of clinicians in digital roles

You can: - own the clinical risk management system for the organisation - set clinical safety policy and assure safety cases for major systems - lead the response to serious safety incidents involving health IT - build a culture of clinical safety across digital teams

skill: Human factors and usability in clinical systems
expected_level_description: You can: - plan and run human factors assessments of clinical systems - turn findings into design changes and clinical safety controls - assess alert burden and the risk of workarounds
You can: - assess whether a product is a medical device, and its likely class - plan the regulatory work for a product with quality and clinical colleagues

You can: - set the clinical direction for the organisation's digital services - lead clinical leaders across organisations through digital change - advise the board on clinical risk and benefit of digital investment
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession

You can: - make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase - build consensus between services or independent stakeholders - identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them - engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick - bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in - facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
You can: - act as a point of escalation - be trusted by senior risk owners as an expert in security - apply risk methodologies at the most complex levels of risk
